text:
maya: Constellation (payments) asked for a 7-day tech POC to replace VendorQ. They want minimal SDK changes, identical response shape, and a billing reconciliation. Smoke test in 6 business days. Can we run?

trent: I can own the shim. Plan: proxy that rewrites requests/responses + prompt normalizer. Need canonical payloads and error codes. 48h for MVP.

li: I'll own the runbook and acceptance criteria. Drafts: 15 canonical prompts >=0.92 semantic parity; response keys identical for parser; p95 latency <500ms in their region; billing reconciliation CSV.

ops-bot: infra: reserved poc cluster constellation-poc in eu-central-1, egress IPs 18.194.22.10, 18.194.22.11. Peering creds sent to maya via DM.

maya: They prefer BYOK/HSM. Dawn-legal, can we provide attestation for Dedicated POC or do they require Private?

dawn-legal: For POC we can provide KMS attestation letter for Dedicated. Production BYOK with HSM requires Private and contract addendum. Flagging as procurement risk.

trent: Tokenizer note: VendorQ tokenizes ~+6%. I'll include a token-report header on each response and a local script for Constellation to reconcile. Example curl for shim: 
curl -X POST https://poc.constellation-shim.redwood.ai/complete -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" -d '{"input":"<sample>","max_tokens":128}'
Return shape will mirror VendorQ: {"request_id":"...","outputs":[{"text":"..."}],"meta":{}}

li: Also request 200 anonymized production samples and their parser test harness. We'll run automated parity and schema tests.

maya: I'll confirm BYOK requirement and schedule a kickoff. If they require full BYOK for POC, escalate to SE + legal.

trent: I'll post the shim repo link and initial tests once ready.

li: Perfect. Add fallback routing to runbook: quantized variant with documented diffs.

maya: Thanks. Kicking off internal checklist and will update after customer kickoff.
